source.title: Ineffectiveness of Reverse Wording of Questionnaire Items: Let's Learn from Cows in the Rain
source.abstract: We did not find evidence that ten reverse-worded items prevented response bias.

interpretation.topic_lens: EASWA preservice survey reverse item interpretation
interpretation.source_locator: PLOS ONE Abstract, Methods and Results, accessed 2026-09-06
interpretation.paper_statement: MFI-20 data from 700 respondents did not support prevention of response bias by reverse wording; authors reported possible inattention and confusion.
interpretation.our_inference: Do not automatically exclude EASWA respondents for inconsistent answers to Q15 and Q18-1.
interpretation.uncertainty: Fatigue questionnaire evidence does not validate the Korean EASWA questionnaire. Only abstract-level evidence captured.
